entities.summary: James Edward Lascelles is an English musician and the second son of the 7th Earl of Harewood and his first wife, Marion. Lascelles is a second cousin to King Charles III. James Lascelles was a composers & musicians from Bayswater (b. 1953-10-05, Bayswater). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
